 Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
 Sugar Land, TX
 Phone 346-555-2185
 Settlement Demand
3-3-25
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1239 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing on behalf of our client, Ryan Roberts, regadring the rear-end collision that occurred on 6-1-24 when your
insured's vehicle struck the rear of our client's vehicle while it was stopped in traffic. The police report and the
photographs taken at the scene document the impact and the resulting damage to our client's vehicle, and liability for
this collision rests squarely with your insured.
Our client sustained neck and back strain as a direct result of the collision. Following the accident, our client sought
prompt medical evaluation and has been undergoing ongoing treatment, including physical therapy and follow-up
care with a treating physician. Our client continues to experience pain and restricted movement, which has affected
daily activities, work responsibilities, and sleep.
Our client's medical expenses, lost income, and the pain and suffering endured to date are detailed in the enclosed
documentation. Taking these losses into account, we demand payment of $113,000.00 in full settlement of all claims
arising from this incident.
Please respond in writing within thirty days of the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within
that period, we will proceed with filing a lawsuit without further notice to your office.
Expert review: Christian Carter, pain management physician
Sincerely,
Carlos Fox
Carter & Smith Injury Lawyers
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
